recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-13308 unless a future work group decision changes the meaning of AdverseEvent.subject or suspectEntity.
issue_request: FHIR-13308 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 change request asking to remove Medication and Device from AdverseEvent.subject because products and devices can be implicated in an adverse event but are not the harmed subject.
initial_application: The issue was applied by commit aa35a1df84ebdc9672816eb997263bcbdd8a460c, titled "removed subject as Device and as Medication. #13308", which changed the historical subject target list from Patient|ResearchSubject|Medication|Device to Patient|ResearchSubject.
additional_context: AdverseEvent remains in current build scope. Later subject-related decisions changed the current subject target list to Patient, Group, Practitioner, and RelatedPerson, including FHIR-13309 adding Practitioner/RelatedPerson and FHIR-40657 removing ResearchSubject. Medication and Device remain available on AdverseEvent.suspectEntity.instance, preserving the Jira comment's subject-vs-implicated-entity distinction.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because source/adverseevent/structuredefinition-AdverseEvent.xml already implements the FHIR-13308 decision.

related_jiras.note: Adjacent Published issue changed the same AdverseEvent.subject reference list by adding Practitioner and RelatedPerson, explaining part of the current target list.
Later Applied issue removed ResearchSubject from AdverseEvent.subject, explaining why the current list differs from the immediate FHIR-13308 application.
